results.name: _cf_METADATA
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE _cf_METADATA (
        key INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        value BLOB
      )

results.name: api_keys
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE api_keys (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                              
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,                            
    api_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,                     
    name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '默认密钥',             
    api_key_type TEXT DEFAULT 'hmac-sha256',          
    rsa_public_key TEXT,                              
    status INTEGER DEFAULT 1,                         
    last_used_at TEXT,                                
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),        
    updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),        
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

results.name: blacklist
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE blacklist (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    type TEXT NOT NULL,                               
    content TEXT NOT NULL,                            
    reason TEXT,                                      
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),        
    UNIQUE(type, content)
)

results.name: channels
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE channels (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                              
    payment_type_id TEXT NOT NULL,                    
    name TEXT NOT NULL,                               
    plugin TEXT NOT NULL,                             
    config TEXT,                                      
    fee_rate REAL DEFAULT 0,                          
    min_amount REAL DEFAULT 0,                        
    max_amount REAL DEFAULT 0,                        
    daily_limit REAL DEFAULT 0,                       
    time_start INTEGER,                               
    time_stop INTEGER,                                
    sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,                     
    status INTEGER DEFAULT 1,                         
    description TEXT,                                 
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),        
    updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),        
    FOREIGN KEY (payment_type_id) REFERENCES payment_types(id)
)

results.name: daily_stats
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE daily_stats (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    date TEXT NOT NULL,                               
    user_id TEXT,                                     
    payment_type TEXT,                                
    order_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,                    
    success_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,                  
    total_amount REAL DEFAULT 0,                      
    success_amount REAL DEFAULT 0,                    
    fee REAL DEFAULT 0,                               
    profit REAL DEFAULT 0,                            
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),        
    UNIQUE(date, user_id, payment_type)
)

results.name: domain_whitelist
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE domain_whitelist (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,                            
    domain TEXT NOT NULL,                             
    status INTEGER DEFAULT 1,                         
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),        
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
    UNIQUE(user_id, domain)
)

results.name: operation_logs
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE operation_logs (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    user_id TEXT,                                     
    action TEXT NOT NULL,                             
    target TEXT,                                      
    detail TEXT,                                      
    ip TEXT,                                          
    user_agent TEXT,                                  
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))         
)

results.name: order_logs
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE order_logs (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                              
    order_id TEXT NOT NULL,                           
    user_id TEXT,                                     
    out_trade_no TEXT,                                
    action TEXT NOT NULL,                             
    from_status INTEGER,                              
    to_status INTEGER,                                
    amount REAL,                                      
    detail TEXT,                                      
    ip TEXT,                                          
    user_agent TEXT,                                  
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),        
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id)
)

results.name: orders
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE orders (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                              
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,                            
    out_trade_no TEXT NOT NULL,                       
    payment_type TEXT NOT NULL,                       
    channel_id TEXT,                                  
    sub_channel_id TEXT,                              
    plugin TEXT,                                      
    amount REAL NOT NULL,                             
    actual_amount REAL,                               
    fee REAL DEFAULT 0,                               
    profit REAL DEFAULT 0,                            
    status INTEGER DEFAULT 0,                         
    name TEXT,                                        
    body TEXT,                                        
    param TEXT,                                       
    buyer TEXT,                                       
    buyer_ip TEXT,                                    
    notify_url TEXT,                                  
    return_url TEXT,                                  
    notify_status INTEGER DEFAULT 0,                  
    notify_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,                   
    last_notify_at TEXT,                              
    domain TEXT,                                      
    device TEXT,                                      
    cert_no TEXT,                                     
    cert_name TEXT,                                   
    api_trade_no TEXT,                                
    refund_amount REAL DEFAULT 0,                     
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),        
    paid_at TEXT,                                     
    closed_at TEXT,                                   
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
)

results.name: password_resets
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE password_resets (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                              
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,                            
    token_hash TEXT NOT NULL,                         
    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,                      
    used_at INTEGER,                                  
    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,              
    ip TEXT,                                          
    user_agent TEXT,                                  
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),        
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

results.name: payment_logs
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE payment_logs (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                              
    order_id TEXT,                                    
    user_id TEXT,                                     
    channel_id TEXT,                                  
    plugin TEXT,                                      
    direction TEXT NOT NULL,                          
    action TEXT NOT NULL,                             
    status TEXT NOT NULL,                             
    amount REAL,                                      
    third_party_trade_no TEXT,                        
    request_data TEXT,                                
    response_data TEXT,                               
    error_message TEXT,                               
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),        
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id)
)

results.name: payment_types
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE payment_types (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                              
    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,                        
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,                       
    icon TEXT,                                        
    description TEXT,                                 
    sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,                     
    status INTEGER DEFAULT 1,                         
    config TEXT,                                      
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),        
    updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))         
)

results.name: reconciliation_logs
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE reconciliation_logs (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                              
    user_id TEXT,                                     
    payment_type TEXT,                                
    date TEXT NOT NULL,                               
    status TEXT NOT NULL,                             
    checked_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,                  
    matched_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,                  
    mismatch_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,                 
    fixed_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,                    
    operator_id TEXT,                                 
    detail TEXT,                                      
    error_message TEXT,                               
    started_at TEXT,                                  
    finished_at TEXT,                                 
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))         
)

results.name: refunds
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE refunds (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                              
    refund_no TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,                   
    order_id TEXT NOT NULL,                           
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,                            
    amount REAL NOT NULL,                             
    reason TEXT,                                      
    status INTEGER DEFAULT 0,                         
    third_party_refund_no TEXT,                       
    error_message TEXT,                               
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),        
    completed_at TEXT,                                
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
)

results.name: settlements
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE settlements (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

    settle_type TEXT,

    reject_reason TEXT,

    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),        
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
)

results.name: users
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                              
    username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,                    
    email TEXT UNIQUE,                                
    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,                      
    salt TEXT NOT NULL,                               
    role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'merchant',            
    status INTEGER DEFAULT 1,                         
    balance REAL DEFAULT 0,                           
    frozen_balance REAL DEFAULT 0,                    
    api_key TEXT UNIQUE,                              
    api_key_type TEXT DEFAULT 'md5',                  
    rsa_public_key TEXT,                              
    notify_url TEXT,                                  
    return_url TEXT,                                  
    contact_qq TEXT,                                  
    contact_wechat TEXT,                              
    contact_phone TEXT,                               
    group_id TEXT,                                    
    settle_type TEXT DEFAULT 'alipay',                
    settle_account TEXT,                              
    settle_name TEXT,                                 
    deposit REAL DEFAULT 0,                           
    today_income REAL DEFAULT 0,                      
    total_income REAL DEFAULT 0,                      
    today_orders INTEGER DEFAULT 0,                   
    total_orders INTEGER DEFAULT 0,                   
    last_login_at TEXT,                               
    last_login_ip TEXT,                               
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),        
    updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))         
)

results.sql:
CREATE TABLE webhook_logs (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
